cards.h1: What a bucks weekend actually costs

cards.text: Lunch, an activity, a booked table after - $120 to $170pp
Add a bar tab and a driver - $200 to $260pp
House split across the group, boat or golf, dinner booked - $320 to $420pp

cards.title: What moves the number
rows: Accommodation. Book it first, it sells out
The groom-s share, split across everyone else

cards.text: People say yes to a number. They do not say yes to a vibe.
